Equipment refers to any item that can be equipped in an equipment slot, as distinguished from items that can only be carried in inventory.

There are 18 equipment slots on a character, as well as 4 bag slots above the Micro Menu and a mount equipment slot in the Mount Journal. The combination of equipment slot and item type is often the first categorization of items used.

Epic is the level of item quality in between and . Epic quality items can be found in end-game instances, from various professions, world drops, and reputation purchases. Although Legendary is one step higher, Epic may often be considered the best in the game. This is due to three reasons: first of all, given how most players will hardly ever see, much less wield a item, Epic items will comprise the "normal" BiS-items a player may acquire. Secondly, due to the rare frequency of implementation of Legendary items, many Epic items will often be better than the game's current best Legendary. Erbag, who lived some eight centuries ago, was a member of the Order of Tirisfal. Erbag supported the council's decision to make Aegwynn the new Guardian. Erbag noticed that, unlike the other apprentices, she was mature enough to handle the position. Erbag later fell into open argument with Aegwynn over her treatment of the Zmodlor incident, admonishing her for rushing in too quickly. Erbag was long dead by the time Aegwynn banished Sargeras.

__NOTOC__ Equips the first matching item found in the player's bags (including the bank and bank bags). Checks the bank first, then carry-ons, then bank bags. local function EquipItemByLink(link) for bag=BANK_CONTAINER, NUM_BAG_SLOTS+NUM_BANKBAGSLOTS do for slot=1,GetContainerNumSlots(bag) do local item = GetContainerItemLink(bag, slot) if item and item == link then if CursorHasItem() or CursorHasMoney() or CursorHasSpell() then ClearCursor() end PickupContainerItem(bag, slot) AutoEquipCursorItem() return true end end end end

The Equipment Manager is a tab within the paper doll that allows switching between sets of equipment. The player can create and alter multiple sets, and switch between them at will. Each set can include a specific item for each slot, or can choose to ignore that slot. Players can also choose titles and icons for their sets. Once created, gear set icons can be added to hotkeys to enable access without opening the Equipment Manager itself.

As part of the upcoming stat-system revamp, we plan to introduce a new tool that will let World of Warcraft players know exactly where they stand in comparison to other players: the Equipment Potency EquivalencE Number. With this new system, you’ll no longer have to wonder about your perceived or actual worth as a player. Erdu'un is a doomguard that appears at the Legion Invasion locations.

The Ephemeral Way is a portion of the Halls of Valor that consists of two areas: the small area around the portal to the Fields of the Eternal Hunt, and the bridge from the Hearth of Revelry to the Hall of Glory. It thus connects various parts of the Halls to one another. When passing through the Ephemeral bridge on the way to the Halls of Glory, one is transformed into a fast-moving ball of pure light.

Environeer Bert is a leper gnome located at the Train Depot in Gnomeregan. He appears to be a gnome who went down inside Gnomeregan to clean it but ended up getting irradiated without realizing it.
